title: Finite projective modules over a connected graded algebra have homogeneous bases
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field] and $A$ a commutative unital $k$-algebra with an internal direct-sum decomposition $A=\bigoplus_{a\geq0}A_a$ into $k$-subspaces, with $A_aA_c\subseteq A_{a+c}$ and $A_0=k\cdot1$ via the given structure map. Set $A_a=0$ for $a<0$. Let $P=\bigoplus_{b\in\mathbf Z}P_b$ be an internally graded $A$-module, with $A_aP_b\subseteq P_{a+b}$, which is finitely generated [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] and projective as an ungraded $A$-module [def-weil-pbc-projective-module]. There exist a finite set $J$, integers $e_r$ and elements $p_r\in P_{e_r}$ such that $(p_r)_{r\in J}$ is an $A$-basis of $P$. Equivalently, with $A(d)_b=A_{b+d}$, the map $\bigoplus_{r\in J}A(-e_r)\to P$, $(a_r)\mapsto\sum_r a_rp_r$, is a degree-preserving $A$-linear isomorphism. The case $P=0$, with $J=\varnothing$, is included. No Noetherian hypothesis or finite-type hypothesis on $A$ is imposed.

source.place: Agent-extracted consequence of Tag 0EKB (lemma-graded-NAK), parts (1) and (4), and the projective lifting property of Tag 05CF (lemma-characterize-projective). This homogeneous-basis enhancement is not the literal statement of either tag.

proof.text: If $P=0$, take the empty family; henceforth assume $P\ne0$, so $A\ne0$. Put $I=A_+$. For each member of a finite ungraded generating set of $P$, take its finitely many homogeneous components. The resulting finite homogeneous family still generates $P$, since it contains expansions of the original generators. Its images span $V=P/IP$ over $k$: in the quotient any coefficient $a=\sum_{n\geq0}a_n$ acts as $a_0\in k\cdot1$. Process this finite homogeneous spanning list in order, retaining a vector exactly when it is outside the span of those previously retained. The retained images form a homogeneous $k$-basis $(\bar p_r)_{r\in J}$ of $V$. Choose their already specified homogeneous representatives $p_r\in P_{e_r}$.

source.place: Tag 0EKB (lemma-graded-NAK), preliminary finite homogeneous generators; elementary finite spanning-list extraction.

proof.text: Let $F=\bigoplus_{r\in J}A(-e_r)$ with standard generators $u_r$ and $F_b=\bigoplus_r A_{b-e_r}u_r$. Decomposing each coefficient in $A$ proves this grading is internal, and $A_aF_b\subseteq F_{a+b}$. The map $q:F\to P$, $u_r\mapsto p_r$, preserves degrees. Apply clause (1) of [lem-sfb-graded-nakayama-connected] to $P$: the lifts generate, so $q$ is surjective. Moreover $\bar q:F/IF\to P/IP$ sends the standard residue basis to $(\bar p_r)$, hence is an isomorphism. Explicitly, if $q(\sum_r a_ru_r)\in IP$, then $\sum_r(a_r)_0\bar p_r=0$, forcing every $(a_r)_0=0$, so every $a_r\in I$; this proves $q^{-1}(IP)=IF$.

The lifting clause of [def-weil-pbc-projective-module], applied to $\operatorname{id}_P$ and the surjection $q$, gives an $A$-linear section $s:P\to F$ with $qs=1$. No grading condition on $s$ is needed. Set $K=\ker q$ and $h=1_F-sq$. Then $qh=0$ and $h|_K=1_K$, so $K$ is generated by the finite family $h(u_r)$: for $x=\sum_ra_ru_r\in K$, one has $x=h(x)=\sum_ra_rh(u_r)$. Independently, $K_b=K\cap F_b$ defines an internal grading of $K$: if $x=\sum_bx_b\in K$, degree preservation gives $0=q(x)=\sum_bq(x_b)$ and internality of $P$ gives $q(x_b)=0$ for every $b$. Scalar compatibility is inherited from $F$.

proof.text: Now $q$ is injective as well as surjective, so the images $p_r=q(u_r)$ form an $A$-basis. Its inverse preserves degrees: for $p\in P_b$ and $q(f)=p$, write $f=\sum_cf_c$; internality of $P$ gives $q(f_c)=0$ for $c\ne b$, and injectivity gives $f_c=0$. Thus $q$ is a degree-preserving isomorphism with the displayed shifted source. The sign is $A(-e_r)_b=A_{b-e_r}$, placing $u_r$ in degree $e_r$. This proves every clause, including the empty family handled in step 1.
